claude_hang_diagnosis.finding: With stdin closed (/dev/null), --permission-prompts none and --no-session-persistence under the minimal env, every print mode call returned within the bound (3 to 63 s; first call of a session spends 25 to 60 s in start up before any API call). All calls failed with 'Credit balance is too low' (HTTP 400), so a full model turn could not be observed.
claude_hang_diagnosis.likely_historic_causes: unconfirmed: an open stdin (print mode reads stdin when it is not a TTY) or a permission prompt waiting for an absent host; the adapter now closes stdin and denies prompts

findings: Claude print mode returns is_error with exit 1 and a result text; the adapter previously counted any result text as success and now fails the check with the CLI's message.
Codex workspace-write sandbox blocks commits; writable runs now pass --add-dir <repo>/.git.

Codex reports token usage (turn.completed) but no cost; a one word probe used about 21k input tokens because of the default system prompt and installed skills (Codex also warns that the skills context budget is exceeded).

python.org Python 3.13 on this Mac has no CA store (CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED); the runtime now falls back to /etc/ssl/cert.pem with verification on. OpenRouter public catalog reachable afterwards (HTTP 200, 458 models, no key sent).
